SASBDB entry SASDJZ4  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDJZ4/)

DNA-PK complex (DNA-PKcs, Ku70/80, DNA)
Publication DOI: paper not reachable (SASBDB lists no DOI used here)
The publisher's PDF is not kept in this folder. The paper was consulted only for SASDRR8
(Europe PMC); the others were unreachable, so their buffer, temperature and wavelength are
the SASBDB entry's (see the header of test/fitting_tests/SASDJZ4/SASDJZ4_fit1.jl).

Files: SASDJZ4_fit1_model1.pdb (SASBDB's model, unmodified), SASDJZ4_fit1.fit (depositor fit),
experimental_data/SASDJZ4.dat. Reference: FoXS 3.655 (header Chi^2 3.65469 = chi2; header says MultiFoXS in SASBDB, BILBOMD-style multi-state fit possible, unconfirmed).
Conditions: 20 °C, 0.103 nm (SASBDB).
Model: 45126 heavy atoms + 8739 H in file, protein + DNA (chains D, E), no HETATM.
